review.reason: The historical Google Coral preconverted TFLite candidate cannot be proven to derive from the already-admitted TensorFlow FaceSSD donor. The previously documented Coral commit pin is also not resolvable through the authoritative GitHub commit API. Filename/architecture/Open Images proximity is not sufficient lineage evidence.

previously_documented_pin.evidence: GitHub REST commit lookup for this repository and SHA returned HTTP 422 / No commit found for SHA during this review. This pin must not be treated as an immutable execution identity.

authoritative_checks.result: No derivation/conversion commit found; file enters history in a parentless initial snapshot and is later removed.
Test-data attribution is present but does not establish model derivation from the admitted TensorFlow donor.

Tests exercise model files but do not document conversion provenance tying this candidate to the admitted donor.

closure.next_smallest_testable_direction: Replan away from this unproven preconverted Coral binary. Any next conversion/runtime hypothesis must preserve the exact admitted donor identity and prove toolchain/runtime provenance before execution.
